help:
/new - Start a vote for a new random map /kill - Kill player (hold for 1 second on foot races) /kill immediately - Kill player without delay (bypassing 1 second delay on foot races) /kill cancel - Cancel delayed kill (on foot races) /togglenametagoutline - Toggle the player nametag outline on or off /cpblips - Choose the number of checkpoint blips/icons to be displayed on the minimap, either 2 or 3. The default is 2. A third is distinguishable by virtue of it having a lower alpha/transparency value.
Keys ---- Enter/Exit - Kill player (hold on foot races)
Admins ------ /config - Configure Race addons /ghostmode - Toggle collisions /checkmap mapname - Find a map /nextmap mapname - Set the next map /random - Change to a random map Change other settings in the Admin panel
